audit.port_worktree: audit fixes committed at 63d4e75; clean tree
audit.baseline_note: Port targets v3.0.0-beta; only upstream tag is v3.0.0. Same generation; single comparison valid.

findings.observed: money_sanitize('-1.005') returned '1.005' (sign lost) because the numeric regex captured only the unsigned digits.
findings.expected: PHP money_sanitize() returns (string)$value, preserving sign; money_round('-1.005') == '-1.00'.
findings.impact: Any negative intermediate money value (refund deltas, discount/fee arithmetic) silently became positive.
findings.fix: Capture the sign inside the regex group (core/money.py:33).

findings.upstream: pp-content/pp-include/pp-functions.php:2409-3035 ($data['transaction'] = raw row with ref/customer_info); gateway class.php callback/process_payment read ['ref']
findings.observed: checkout_payment passed transaction_payload(txn) (keys pp_id/amount/... but no 'ref'/'customer_info') to gateway plugins. Every API gateway callback compared provider data against data['transaction']['ref'] == None, so verification failed; process_payment embedded an empty reference (payment links, invoicing, Binance bpid).
findings.expected: Gateway classes receive the raw transaction row: ref and customer_info present.
findings.impact: Financial integrity: valid payments could not be matched/confirmed; provider orders carried empty merchant references.
findings.fix: Add ref=txn.ref and customer_info=txn.customer_info to txn_ctx (checkout/views.py:238-240).

findings.observed: path('invoice/webhook/', views.invoice_page) bound a view requiring a positional `ref` argument; every POST raised TypeError -> HTTP 500.
findings.impact: Invoice webhook endpoint was completely non-functional (unhandled exception).
findings.fix: Pass {'ref': 'webhook'} kwargs on both webhook URL entries.

findings.observed: Binance IPN returned {status,visible_number} instead of {status,title,message}; the IPN view returned the JSON body before applying verified, so pp_set_transaction_status was never called and the transaction was never completed.
findings.expected: Complete the transaction, then echo {status:'true', title:'Transaction Verified', message:'...'}.
findings.impact: Binance payments never reached 'completed' despite a verified IPN.
findings.fix: Apply verified-completion before returning json (ipn_views.py); align Binance JSON/messages to class.php.

findings.observed: Inherited tests encoded expectations contradicting upstream (MISSING_FIELD vs INVALID_URL order; Duplicate-Transaction-ID vs Code 101 on re-verify).
findings.impact: False confidence / would have masked the real validation order.
findings.fix: Corrected expectations and added a dedicated duplicate-guard case.

findings.observed: BCryptSHA256PasswordHasher is first; its SHA-256 pre-hash is not PHP-compatible, yet the comment claims legacy rows verify.
findings.expected: Raw bcrypt (BCryptPasswordHasher) if legacy hash import is intended.
findings.impact: Migration from a PHP database would lock out every user.
findings.fix: Not applied — needs a migration/back-compat decision. See improvement-roadmap R4.

findings.observed: requests calls use verify=False (TLS verification disabled).
findings.impact: MITM exposure of gateway traffic / FX rates.
findings.fix: Enable verification (roadmap R5).

findings.observed: Module/update import extracts an admin-supplied zip over APP_ROOT and executes its sql.sql via run_sql(), all admin-gated.
findings.expected: Upstream parity (admin-level code execution by design).
findings.impact: Compromise of one admin account = full code execution.
findings.fix: Accept as documented risk or sandbox; see roadmap R6.

findings.observed: Hardcoded fallback SECRET_KEY and ALLOWED_HOSTS='*' when env vars unset; DEBUG defaults off.
findings.impact: Predictable signing key and Host-header attacks if deployed with defaults.
findings.fix: Fail fast when DEBUG is false and SECRET_KEY is default (roadmap R7).

findings.observed: Gateway API credentials stored as plain text in the database.
findings.expected: At-rest encryption (upstream does not, so parity).
findings.impact: DB read = credential theft.
findings.fix: Optional field encryption; roadmap R8.

findings.observed: Self-edit blocked with 302 redirect + message; upstream returns HTTP 403 'You can't edit your info'.
findings.impact: Cosmetic/protocol difference; no data impact.
findings.fix: Optional: return 403 (roadmap P3).

findings.observed: models docstring claims an existing PipraPay MySQL DB is reusable without data migration, but created_date/updated_date are varchar upstream vs DateTimeField here. README listed 108 tests / 4 test files (now 205 / 8).
findings.impact: Operator confusion; misleading reuse claim.
findings.fix: Correct the docstring and README test counts (roadmap D1).

findings.observed: bcrypt dependency exists; hashing uses BCryptSHA256 (see SEC-2).
findings.impact: See SEC-2.
findings.fix: Merge with SEC-2.

findings.observed: Upstream composite indexes modeled as smaller/single-column indexes.
findings.impact: Possible query-plan divergence at scale; unmeasured.
findings.fix: Add composite indexes after query profiling.

findings.observed: No concurrency test for set_transaction_status duplicate-callback path; no live/mock coverage for SSLCommerz/OxaPay/NOWPayments/refund-failure; no MySQL run; no failure-injection matrix.
findings.impact: Untested financial state-machine and provider branches.
findings.fix: See improvement-roadmap R1-R3. R1 (state-machine) was already covered by tests/test_security.py::StateMachineTests; R3 (provider timeout/malformed response) is now covered by tests/test_workflows.py::FailureInjectionTests. Remaining: live provider branches + MySQL.

findings.observed: Device pairing token is a 10-digit numeric OTP (M.generate_item_id()) and the companion login endpoint is unauthenticated with no rate limiting.
findings.impact: Companion API token guessable within ~10^10 attempts, enabling SMS data ingest/exfiltration for a paired device.
findings.fix: Use secrets.token_urlsafe for the OTP and add login throttling; diverges from upstream, needs a decision.

findings.observed: Production mode (DJANGO_SECURE=1) did not reject a default SECRET_KEY or wildcard ALLOWED_HOSTS.
findings.expected: Fail fast on insecure production config.
findings.impact: Deployment with dev defaults yields a predictable signing key and Host-header exposure.
findings.fix: Added validate_production_settings() invoked when DJANGO_SECURE=1.

findings.upstream: pp-content/pp-modules/pp-gateways action-v2 transaction-verify (no CSRF concept in PHP)
findings.observed: The three gateway verify forms POST via fetch() with no CSRF token while verify_endpoint has no csrf_exempt, so real browsers (which enforce CSRF, unlike Django's default test client) get HTTP 403 on every payer Verify/Submit click. Invoice and payment-link fetch forms already carried tokens.
findings.expected: Payer verification succeeds in a real browser.
findings.impact: All automation/manual gateway payer verifications broken in production; payer sees 'Request Error'.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_ui.py::CheckoutRenderTests::test_verify_endpoint_enforces_csrf (enforce_csrf_checks client: 403 without token, 200 JSON with token)
findings.fix: Added {% csrf_token %} to all three verify forms (FormData submits it).

findings.observed: No /admin/brand-setting/ landing page existed; the five sub-pages were reachable only via the sidebar dropdown. Upstream has an 'All Settings' hub with per-resource permission gating.
findings.impact: Minor navigation gap; direct /admin/brand-setting/ URL 404'd.
findings.fix: Added brand_setting_index view (brand_settings page gate + per-card resource view checks), route, template, and sidebar 'All Settings' link.

findings.observed: Local QRCode fallback rendered {text: <unquoted URL>} — a JS syntax error, so the in-browser 2FA QR never drew (the external qrserver image still showed).
findings.impact: Cosmetic; external QR image unaffected.
findings.reproduction: template review (no dedicated test; covered by my-account render sweep)
findings.fix: Quoted the escapejs output: {text: "{{ qr_url|escapejs }}"}.
